How it is made

Drawn from docs/changes.md, each journey's Status history and the prototype's proofs. List the date each update starts in project.md, oldest first: updates: [YYYY-MM-DD, …]. The last is the current Update; each earlier one keeps its own page. Without dates there is one, covering everything. Print it with one slide per page and choose Save as PDF; npm run share puts it in the folder you send. Also generated: pitch, stakeholder deck. Choose the decks in project.md: presentation: [pitch, stakeholders, update].

Notes · 2 / 5 · What changed
  • 2026-10-28: Review a document split into four journeys (Manage a thread, Go through every comment, Say who you are); Review a slide deck and Collect feedback from several reviewers added (FR-013 to FR-021).
  • 2026-10-28: Review on a phone, Come back to a page later and Add Pipeup to a page added (FR-022 to FR-029).
  • 2026-10-28: Type scale raised and the measure and page widened so screens fill their frame (D-013).
  • 2026-11-10: Enable Share for the requested Pipeup/Designup feedback trial, refresh the generated outputs and prototype proofs, and record the confirmed public-design/private-submission scope in D-015. The new submission and owner-inbox interaction remains a proposal, separate from the existing nine designed journeys.
  • 2026-11-26: The design aligned with Pipeup 1.1.0 (D-016): FR-002 (first-run hints, no outline while a thread is open), FR-003 and FR-004 (a sent comment closes to a compact card; a card opens to read with a quiet reply line), FR-005 (the ⋯ opens the menu; the Markdown reads as a message), FR-007 (selecting words offers a comment outside comment mode), FR-009 (six quick reactions and a "more"), FR-021 (Copy for my agent and Paste my agent's replies replace the prompt card), FR-022 (one tap starts commenting; press and hold for the menu), FR-024 (the key is offered, not required), and the script and check pins moved to 1.1.0.
  • 2026-11-26: Comment on any page in Safari added (FR-030 to FR-035); Content gone describes the relocation ask and Collect feedback the "Only in this browser" mark (D-017).
  • 2026-11-26: The design system takes Pipeup's own look (D-018): colour, type, radius, depth, the highlight and the picked block; cmp-browser-chrome drawn as Safari. No requirement changed.
  • 2026-11-26: Safari's permission question drops from Pipeup's toolbar button as a popover (D-019). No requirement changed.
  • 2026-11-27: Presentation and Investor facts switched on; the Pitch, the Stakeholder deck and the Update are generated. The brief's Vision, Why now, The gap and The bridge are open questions until a person writes them. No requirement changed.
  • 2026-11-27: The brief's Market and Competition written from market research Kevin confirmed (review of the Pitch, slide 6), with Google Docs and Microsoft Word as the baseline people expect; no requirement changed.
  • 2026-11-27: The brief's Why now, The gap and The bridge written in Kevin's words from his review of the Pitch (slides 2 to 4); Why now's figures wait on research he checks. No requirement changed.
  • 2026-11-27: Why now gains its sourced figures (AI content on the web, WordPress's reach, ChatGPT's users), the vendors' lock-in and the history of open formats, from research Kevin confirmed. No requirement changed.
